decision: Leave direct integer QK outside product dispatch. Both direct and shared integer schedules preserve every compared original raw score and CPU sampled dot, but direct loading takes687.154ms including key/query encoding, shared takes542.3215ms, and original scalar takes446.0553ms including key transpose. Removing CTA barriers does not improve this QK schedule. Keep the qualified direct-PV product stack; next separate native-QK probability and denominator differences to evaluate broader elimination of exact score work.
